title: UpsertSanctionedEntity
description: A SanctionedEntity from the EU FSD list. The Virtuoso sink renders this into fontem:SanctionedEntity triples in the http://data.fontem.eu/graph/sanctions named graph; the Neo4j sink renders it as a :SanctionedEntity node MERGE'd on entity_id. Persons are filtered upstream (GDPR posture); only entity-typed rows reach the event log.
